scripts.build: pnpm --filter @trail/contracts build && pnpm --filter @trail/dev-skill-router build && pnpm --filter @trail/skill-corpus build && pnpm --filter @trail/api build && pnpm --filter @trail/web build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @trail/contracts build && pnpm --filter @trail/skill-corpus build && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "pnpm --filter @trail/api dev" "pnpm --filter @trail/web dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @trail/contracts build && pnpm --filter @trail/skill-corpus build && pnpm -r typecheck
